lavenet.title: LaveNet
lavenet.tagline: A laundry web app for Abidjan: online ordering, pickup and delivery slots, order tracking and a back office. Usable end to end today.
lavenet.lead: A laundry web app (washing, ironing, dry cleaning) for Abidjan. Customers order online, pick their handover method along with their collection and delivery slots, then follow their order as it progresses. On the owner's side, a back office drives the statuses.
features: Full authentication: sign-up, phone verification by OTP, password reset, profile and address book
Catalogue and pricing, prerendered so they show up instantly
Online ordering: cart, handover method, capacity-limited collection and delivery slots, checkout
Order tracking with a progress timeline, and cancellation
Back office: status changes driven by a state machine

decisions.title: Nx monorepo
decisions.description: The Angular front end and the NestJS API live in the same repository and share their types.

decisions.title: Angular 21, zoneless
decisions.description: Signals for state, no more zone.js, and prerendering for the public pages (catalogue, pricing) so the first paint is immediate.

decisions.title: API contract generated and checked in CI
decisions.description: The contract is generated from the back end and diffed on every build: a mismatch between API and front end breaks CI instead of reaching production.

decisions.title: State machine for order statuses
decisions.description: Transitions are validated server-side, so the back office cannot move an order into an inconsistent state.

decisions.title: Prisma and PostgreSQL
decisions.description: Versioned schema, reproducible migrations and a managed database.

lavenet.note: Free hosting: the first sign-in can take about twenty seconds while the server wakes up. The public pages are prerendered and show up instantly.

akynova.title: AKYNOVA GROUP
akynova.tagline: A platform for an Ivorian services group with five departments: marketing site, customer area, admin panel and blog. Client project, delivered and in production.
akynova.lead: A web platform for an Ivorian services group spanning five departments. The marketing site introduces the group, the customer area handles requests and appointment booking, and the admin panel gives the group control over all of it.
features: Marketing site: the group and its five departments
Customer area: requests, appointment booking, profile

decisions.title: Next.js 16 with the App Router
decisions.description: Server rendering for the public marketing pages, client rendering kept for the authenticated areas.

decisions.title: NextAuth v5 and roles
decisions.description: One authentication layer for two surfaces — the customer area and the admin panel — separated by roles.

decisions.title: Prisma and PostgreSQL
decisions.description: Requests, appointments, blog posts and accounts in a single schema, with versioned migrations.

decisions.title: Tailwind CSS v4
decisions.description: CSS-first configuration, with the group's visual identity carried by theme variables.

akynova.note: This is a client site in production: there are no demo credentials, and the source code isn't public.

fiscalci.title: FiscalCI
fiscalci.tagline: A compliance-checking platform for electronic standardized invoices and refund-file preparation for VAT tax credits, for businesses in Côte d'Ivoire. Development hasn't started.
fiscalci.lead: Businesses that are structurally in VAT credit — approved exporters, industrial operators, mining companies — tie up significant amounts of cash. Building a refund file takes several days of manual work, and a single non-compliant purchase invoice in the batch triggers a rejection that extends the cash tie-up.
roadmap: Compliance checks for electronic standardized invoices
Manual anomaly resolution with tracked justification

decisions.title: Never calls the FNE issuance API
decisions.description: The product never calls an issuance endpoint of the Electronic Standardized Invoicing platform: it never substitutes itself for a invoice's tax certification.

decisions.title: Never stores a client's API key
decisions.description: A client's FNE API key is never held by the product, so it never becomes a compromise point for the invoice-issuance system.

decisions.title: Never issues or certifies an invoice
decisions.description: The product checks the compliance of invoices that are already issued and certified; it never issues or certifies an invoice itself.

decisions.title: Never communicates automatically with the tax authority
decisions.description: The refund file is prepared for the business itself to file; the product never communicates automatically with the tax authority.

state: Requirements at version 1.1, written after reviewing the DGI's technical and regulatory documentation
Still needed before any prototyping: field interviews with accounting firms and finance departments
Still needed before any prototyping: access to the DGI test environment, requested
Development not started: no demo, no code to show
fiscalci.note: Zero rejections, zero back-and-forth: the product doesn't claim to speed up the administration's decision — it guarantees the filed dossier is airtight and fully documented.
